why: MI-280 unit U11. Discharges CLAUSE (2) ONLY of BL-20260912-REGISTER-RESERIALIZATION-IS-CAUGHT-ONLY-BY-A-CANARY-SELFTEST-IN-ANOTHER-TOOL-THAT-NAMES-A-DIFFERENT-CONDITION; clause (1), the ARMING half, belongs to BL-20260906-REGISTER-MERGE-DRIVER-SHIPS-UNARMED-AND-A-SESSION-PAID-ELEVEN-HAND-RESOLUTIONS and is untouched, so the row stays kept_open and names which half moved. Tier-1 tooling: scripts/ci/**, tests/**, docs/claude/health-review-backlog.json. No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no order path, no strategy config, no risk cap. NOT landing machinery — checked by importing check_pr_landing.py and printing all twelve entries; the only one this diff matches is the `.github/pr-landing/*.json` glob, i.e. this declaration itself, which R12 excludes by construction (otherwise no PR could ever declare). THE DEFECT: a PR can rewrite a shared register without losing a single row — nothing lost, and still a defect, because the file is re-attributed to that PR, every sibling branch touching it conflicts, and the row-level history goes. The only thing that noticed on 2026-09-12 was manager_preflight's self-test hardcoding 'OPEN-ITEMS.json does not round-trip' as an expectation: a canary that fires on churn as a SIDE EFFECT, reads as a broken self-test rather than a corrupted register, invites a session to 'fix' it by editing the expectation, and dies silently if that file ever becomes round-trippable. THE MEASURE IS A CONJUNCTION AND HISTORY IS WHY, NOT ARGUMENT. POPULATION: every commit-vs-first-parent pair that changed one of the five driver-bound registers over the last 400 commits touching each — 1768 pairs. `lost > budget` ALONE returned 13 findings, four of them ordinary merges at ratios 1.02x–2.79x. Re-serialization is a WHOLE-FILE property and on that axis the separation is not close: nine members at 0.960–0.975, a gap of 0.58 with nothing in it, then 0.378 and below. The 0.75 floor sits in that empty middle and anything in [0.40, 0.95] gives identical verdicts on that population — a CHOSEN value with a measured basis, not one tuned until the tree passed. Final: 1757 clean / 9 reserialized / 2 unreadable, and all nine are OPEN-ITEMS.json, the one file the merge driver names as not byte-reproducible. THE TWO `unreadable` CASES ARE REAL AND ARE THE ARGUMENT FOR THAT STATE EXISTING: a register was committed WITH CONFLICT MARKERS IN IT (b66d4ad91) and repaired one minute later (4c79a7eab); a guard that merely parsed and shrugged would have called that clean. IT FOUND A LIVE INSTANCE IMMEDIATELY, ON MY OWN WORK: commit 3fc12c412 on PR #11898 rewrote 1774 of 1819 lines (97.5%) of OPEN-ITEMS.json to add ONE row, five hours after the incident this row was filed for. Repaired there by byte-splicing main's exact bytes plus the one row (1773 added / 1778 removed -> 15 added / 1 removed), with the splice asserting its own correctness rather than trusting a round-trip on a file where only 3 of 85 rows reproduce under any canonical dump. The other ELEVEN MI-280 branches graded clean — the positive control that the probe is not firing on everything. SCOPE IS STATED RATHER THAN IMPLIED: the register set is read from .gitattributes, never a second hardcoded list, and the count of register-shaped JSON files nobody bound to the driver is printed on every run, so `clean` can never be read as full coverage. VERIFICATION: 17 controls plus an 11-assertion --self-test; 8 planted defects, 8 caught, positive control quiet on restore. ⚠️ TWO PLANTS ESCAPED ON THE FIRST RUN and both were the same shape — a control that cannot SEPARATE the branch it targets: deleting the budget escaped because every existing control satisfied the floor too, and measuring `lost` in the wrong direction escaped because a re-serialization is large in BOTH directions. Two asymmetric controls were added (a large honest REMOVAL, and a large honest APPEND) and both plants are now caught. That is the fifth instance of this shape in one day and the recurrence is itself the finding. ⚠️ manager_preflight's self-test is DELIBERATELY NOT TOUCHED: it is still the only detector for that file's round-trip property, and weakening it to accept a round-trippable OPEN-ITEMS.json would remove detection while making CI green — the exact trade the row exists to prevent. ⚠️ AND WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO: it does not arm the merge driver and does not make a `dirty` PR mergeable on GitHub. It makes the corruption VISIBLE at the PR, which is strictly later than preventing it.
